name: fastify-best-practices
title_zh: 把 Fastify 后端开发钉在最佳实践轨道上
tagline_zh: 路由、插件、校验、鉴权、CORS、WebSocket——不用再翻文档拼碎片。照着做，TypeScript 或 JS。
tagline_en: Routes, plugins, validation, auth, CORS, WebSocket—no more doc-scavenging. Follow it and your TS/JS REST API.
desc_en: Guides development of Fastify Node.js backend servers and REST APIs using TypeScript or JavaScript. Use when building, configuring, or debugging a Fastify application — including defining routes, implementing plugins, setting up JSON Schema validation, handling errors, optimising performance, managing authentication, configuring CORS and security headers, integrating databases, working with WebSoc
why_zh: 不是零散技巧，而是把 Fastify 官方维护者的实战决策固化成可执行的规则集——从路由设计到错误处理。
why_en: Not scattered tips—it codifies the maintainer's production decisions into executable rules, from route design to error handling.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Fastify 生态；Express、NestJS 或纯 Node http 一概不管。且不含部署、监控。
limit_en: Fastify-only; nothing for Express/NestJS/raw Node. No deployment, monitoring, or log shipping—stops at code level, ops needs separate tooling.
